title: Befriending John Wheeler at a New Jersey retirement community
place_text: New Jersey; Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton

tellings.quote: lived in New Jersey for a period of time worked for an entity that worked for the intelligence community and my wife wife was a nurse at a retire in a retirement community

plain: A man named Bob Maguire, who describes himself as a contractor for the CIA, says he got to know the physicist John Wheeler, a figure tied to the Institute for Advanced Study, a research centre in Princeton, at a retirement community in New Jersey. Maguire tells it firsthand: he lived in New Jersey for a while, worked for an outfit that served the intelligence community, and his wife was a nurse at the retirement community, which is how the friendship began.
